title: Claim Reimbursement Lag Alert
dataSources: Trupanion claims (`trupanion:claim`), vet invoices (`vet:invoice`), pet insurance premiums (`petinsurance:premium`), and vet visits (`vet:visit`).
app: Trupanion claim exports, veterinary invoice logs, pet insurance premium bills, and vet visit records streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=trupanion:claim days_to_pay=* claim_status=*
| where days_to_pay>14 AND claim_status!="paid"
| sort - days_to_pay
| table pet_name reimbursement_usd days_to_pay claim_status
description: Lists Trupanion claims unpaid more than fourteen days after submission.
value: Reimbursement lag ties up cash flow for vet bills you expected insurance to cover quickly.
implementation: Track `days_to_pay` from submission to deposit and follow up on claims past your normal window.
visualization: Table of claims sorted by days to pay.
grandmaExplanation: It tracks pet insurance claims that have taken more than two weeks to pay out.
